definitions: A male given name of Latin origin, meaning 'soldier'.
Miles Davis (1926-1991), an American jazz trumpeter, bandleader, and composer.
Miles Prower, also known as Tails, a character in the Sonic the Hedgehog series.
examples: Miles is coming to the party.
The Miles family lives next door.
Have you heard Miles Davis's 'Kind of Blue'?
Miles Prower can fly with his two tails.
